name: Logan 2-Person Outdoor Infrared Sauna
description: Description Imagine stepping outside—into quiet morning air or a cool evening breeze—and slipping into the warm, enveloping glow of your own outdoor infrared sanctuary. The moment you close the door, the world softens. Stress dissolves. Muscles exhale. And what remains is a space that feels unmistakably yours: peaceful, restorative, and ready whenever you are. The Logan 2-Person Outdoor Infrared Sauna isn’t just an addition to your patio—it becomes the wellness ritual that anchors your day. A statement of care for your body, your recovery, and the home environment you want to create. It’s the choice discerning homeowners make when they want professional-level rejuvenation without ever leaving their space. Why do you think infrared heat has become a cornerstone practice for so many health-minded homeowners and high performers? Because the benefits compound: deeper relaxation, improved circulation, stress release, and the ability to reset your mind and body in a matter of minutes. When the sauna is beautifully built, weather-ready, and always waiting at the perfect temperature… consistency becomes effortless. And here’s the truth—this isn’t a purchase you “use when you remember.” This is a long-term wellness asset. A one-time investment that transforms your patio into a year-round retreat and gives you a place to restore, recover, and reconnect with yourself daily. The kind of upgrade that feels better with time. Imagine a few weeks from now: stepping into the aged Canadian hemlock, the chromatherapy colors shifting gently, music playing through the integrated Bluetooth system, and the quiet certainty that this moment is for you. This is your new normal—a home that supports your health as intentionally as you support your life. Features Weatherproof sealed and painted exterior for year-round outdoor durability, giving you confidence no matter the climate. Metal/composite roof engineered to stand up to the elements and provide long-lasting structural protection. Aged Canadian Hemlock construction for a naturally beautiful, calming, spa-quality interior that elevates your outdoor space. Far infrared heating system quickly warms your sauna to ~140°F, delivering deep, restorative heat that supports circulation and muscle recovery. Interior and exterior LED lighting to create an inviting atmosphere day or night. Color-changing chromatherapy enhances mood, promotes balance, and elevates every session into a sensory ritual. Digital control panel for intuitive, at-a-glance temperature and session adjustments. Bluetooth sound system so you can enjoy guided meditations, playlists, or relaxing soundscapes. Air purification system for fresher, cleaner air inside every session—critical for a truly restorative experience. Cup holders and thoughtful details that make it easy to settle in and stay present. 2800-watt system provides consistent, powerful performance. 240V, 20-amp electrical setup for straightforward installation while meeting all US and Canadian safety standards. What's Included?
